description: This file defines a PHP trait named ThemeServiceTrait within the namespace OrangeHRM\CorporateBranding\Traits. The trait provides a method to retrieve a ThemeService instance from a service container to be used within classes that include this trait. It includes use statements for related traits and service classes, and comments indicate its role in the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getThemeService
methods.description: Returns an instance of the ThemeService by fetching it from the dependency injection container.
